title: Battle of Kizaki
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Kizaki", at revision 1370267198, opens: "The Battle of Kizaki (木崎原の戦い) occurred on the 4th day of the fifth month of Genki 3 when the forces of Shimazu Yoshihiro defeated the larger army of Itō Yoshisuke. The battle, also known as "The Okehazama of Kyushu"." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4871457, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1572 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
